title: contradiction must be resolved
why: The shop has said two incompatible things. Compiling either one silently picks a winner and the losing technician's jobs start failing for reasons nobody can see.

shop.stakes: hire bikes on city streets; a wheel coming loose is a serious injury and we have had one near miss

conversation.said: Wheel security check before every hire.
Quick release done up tight, you should not be able to move it by hand.
Yeah we torque the axle nuts to 18 Nm on the e-bikes.
Are the hire bikes quick release or bolt-up axles?
Both, depends on the bike. Same check though.
